decisions.reason: Because the firm has invested in this glass flake spraying system and can attribute slow uptake to temporary market conditions, escalation of commitment makes keeping more likely.
The dedicated website page signals public commitment, and as a low-pressure injection pump close to core offerings it is central, so the firm persists.
Though only mentioned online, it builds on established pump technology and sunk costs imply the firm will keep it despite limited visibility.
